cost_interpretation.reason: The historical run persisted final routing outcomes but did not record per-record human-review decisions or elapsed research time. Do not infer labor cost or throughput from PR/CI counts.

provenance.claim: 60 records were structured; 24 existing holdings were stopped; 36 holdings and 35 Works were added; 61 verified Editions were registered.
The input cohort was 60 fully visible Kindle bookshelf records and bibliographic fields were to be verified against publisher or National Diet Library sources.
The normalized records are persisted in data/issue-1-books.json with source-backed Edition metadata.

measurement_gap.next_measurement: Capture these fields on the next real 100-1000 record migration so manual-review rate and records/hour are observed rather than inferred.
